answer: Proof-of-personhood seats plus a bonded entry gate stop Sybil swarms. Each agent must post a non-refundable bond scaling with its number of live identities, so N clones cost N times the stake, and joining the trust graph means being vouched at a vertex by already-bonded peers. Cheap identities never spiral into a majority, since a fresh key with no vetted pearl of history sits outside the quorum that decides payouts and emits no reward. Duplicated work is caught on-ledger and the forged cluster is slashed, burning the attacker's stake.
